Temple elephant dies after lightning strike in Kerala

Pallattu Brahmadathan, a temple elephant in Kerala, died after being struck by lightning. The elephant had been a familiar presence at temple festivals across Kerala for nearly three decades. People gathered at its home to catch a final glimpse before its cremation.
